target.quantity: active winding AC excess = total Joule minus prescribed transport DC
target.scope: full motor, active length only; eight sectors, 0.15m active length
target.average: P2 uniform post-step mean, original steps257..512
target.qualification: historical P2 current gates retained; whole-history, period and mesh qualities remain separate. New Ref_P117 numerical experiments do not replace the frozen target set.
target.denominator: canonical mean-square-field Hybrid, original 128phase x600 spatial |B| samples plus skin-excess; no new evaluator substitution

graph.source: Ref24 recovered ALL_A_HISTORY.npz and original mesh topology
graph.edge_definition: unique undirected pairs from each original FE triangle, duplicated both directions; no kNN
graph.domain_scope: six stationary homogenized slots, disconnected across slots; no discrete copper boundary, moving rotor or periodic boundary graph
graph.node_coordinate_units: m in original stationary global Cartesian frame
graph.B_input_or_supervision: B is supervision only, not a forward-input feature. The learned encoder maps geometry/condition/phase to latent and B. The Full residual head uses that frozen conditional latent.
graph.edge_features: destination minus source normalized xy, Euclidean norm
graph.B_target: element P1 curl of A, then incident-element area-weighted projection to nodes; float32 T
graph.node_weight: sum incident element area/3, normalized by total selected domain area
graph.phase_monitor: indices7,15,...,127 excluded from optimizer batches; MS only
graph.disposable_GPU_sanity: The discarded20-update sanity net uses first8source/phase pairs, including phase index7 once. No sanity weights, optimizer state or seed stream enter any final net. Phase exclusion refers to the3 final networks; no globally-never-opened claim is made for MS phases.
graph.interface_policy: original node IDs retained; slot domains are disconnected. No coordinate-based ID merging. Copper J or Motor-CAD Je terminology is not introduced.
graph.projection_limit: This projection and vector-B MSE do not preserve mean(B squared) automatically. Canonical loss always uses the separately audited original spatial sample evaluator.
graph.training_tensor: MS_graph_data.npz remains in private raw storage; source SHA256 values and deterministic builder provided

residual_head.learned_features: 96 values: area-weighted48-dimensional node latent pooled over128phases by phase mean and standard deviation
residual_head.normalization: fit-subset mean and standard deviation, then block dimension normalization; no eval rows used to fit preprocessing
residual_head.hyperparameters: 9 Gaussian ridge candidates, leave-one-MS-source-group-out CV on63 calibration rows only
residual_head.cost: 3 frozen neural seeds reported separately; no best-seed selection. MS solves and graph encoding are extra LF costs, not extra Full labels. Existing AF also requires canonical MS/Hybrid inputs.

split.HalfSC_statement: No HalfSC labels or fields used in this run's training/pretraining/tuning. Historical QC and prior AF evaluation exist; do not call it globally never-opened.
split.MS_mapping: existing exact/bounded mapping retained; maximum source current difference0.0375A in Ref-normalized units

new_FEA_readback_scope: Full-time scalar/current reconstructed from native A plus circuit voltage using BE/BDF2. Sparse-J reintegration agreement checks reader/shard consistency, not an independent second solver loss output. Historical adoptedP2 and prescribed currents are independent comparison references.
